entries.41245a4013facb70: Based on its management philosophy of “Spirit of Enterprise” and “Mind of Self-Benefit and Benefit to Others,” the company has been advancing its medium-term management plan “Jumping over the 130th ～Toward a Future of Growth～” since April 2024. The fiscal year ended March 2026 is the final year of this plan, and the company states that it will work to implement various measures toward completing the plan.

entries.e8bf204c100116d5: The company was founded in 1896 as a wool spinning and weaving company, but its revenue is now mainly from the Commercial Facilities Business, followed by the Healthcare Business (bedding products) and the Fiber Business (textiles). While retaining its textile-related businesses since its founding, leasing and operation of commercial facilities has become its largest business.
